acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-transit passes; stoa-transit binary builds
description:
Add DnsAuthCache to PipelineCtx and call cache_from_article in run_pipeline.

Files: crates/transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs, crates/transit/src/main.rs, crates/transit/src/rnews_main.rs

pipeline.rs:
  Add to PipelineCtx: pub dns_auth_cache: Option<&'a DnsAuthCache>
  In run_pipeline, after verify_article:
    if let Some(cache) = ctx.dns_auth_cache { cache.cache_from_article(article_bytes).await; }

main.rs:
  Construct at startup: let dns_auth_cache = DnsAuthCache::new(transit_pool.clone(), Arc::clone(&ipfs), Arc::clone(&dns_cache));
  Add to PipelineCtx: dns_auth_cache: Some(&dns_auth_cache)

rnews_main.rs:
  Add to PipelineCtx: dns_auth_cache: None (stoa-rnews has no dns_cache)

Defensive rules:
  Option<&DnsAuthCache> means None disables caching with no change to existing callers.
  cache_from_article never propagates errors so pipeline error contract unchanged.
  All existing tests pass with dns_auth_cache: None.
title: Wire DnsAuthCache into pipeline.rs
